title: Proof Checker
subtitle: Keeper of Euclid's Reasoning
bodyText: A proof checker questions every inference and tests whether a construction truly follows. This exacting reader guards the chain of reasoning, making an elegant conclusion worthy of the certainty it claims.
sceneBrief: A proof checker works with a compass and ruler on a geometrical proof sheet. The head inclines gently forward in a natural three-quarter view and the eyes follow the compass tip on the sheet. Keep the neck relaxed above the shoulders and preserve the drafting hands, compass, ruler and nearby collaborator.
